vibe_rationale: Twenty-year surf-culture music festival in Chile's surf capital with surf-film links and sustainability campaigns; a strong scene, though a one-day concert format.
fit_notes: Adult surf and outdoor crowd in a coastal town, with hydration, recovery and ocean-health fit; the line-up mixes surf-culture musicians with reggae and rap acts. A presenting bank with several partners and media, but no partnership page or contact was found. Existing surf shops and sustainability campaigns suit a recovery or ocean-health activation. Activation would need a Chilean partner.
